architecture.mechanism: Insulation resistance of the stack decreases as coolant conductivity and temperature increase, with conductivity having a greater impact, so controlling coolant properties preserves internal insulation integrity.
architecture.intervention: Replace the standard ethylene-glycol coolant with a deionized, low-conductivity coolant formulation and install an in-line coolant conductivity/temperature sensor that triggers a warning and isolation valve if conductivity rises above threshold, allowing detection and sealing of micro-leaks that are not externally visible by virtue of the conductivity change they induce.
architecture.expected_effect: Micro-leaks or weeping gasket failures will cause a measurable rise in coolant conductivity and local temperature, which the sensor detects, isolating the leak path before the engine overheats and enabling pinpoint sealing without requiring visible external damage.
architecture.falsification_test: On a bench cooling loop representative of the Sorento's engine cooling system, introduce a controlled micro-leak of 0.5 mL/min at a hidden internal joint; verify whether coolant conductivity rises above the calibrated threshold within 30 minutes and whether the isolation logic triggers; if conductivity does not measurably change at this leak rate, the conductivity-based detection mechanism is falsified.
